# Product Marketing

Define product marketing context for consistent positioning and messaging.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

When the user wants to create or update the product marketing context doc (.agents/product-marketing.md), or asks what belongs in it or whether positioning or ICP is clear enough: product, ICP, positioning, competitors, customer language, brand voice. Use it before other marketing skills on a new project, when the audience or positioning changes, and to log learnings.

Example request:

> Use product-marketing to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill product-marketing
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/product-marketing/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/product-marketing/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
